high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from the account @RT_com, which appears to be from the Russian state-owned news agency RT. The tweet was posted 38 seconds before the screenshot was taken. The text on the tweet reads: "Bright mysterious FIREBALL blasts across Sweden’s sky." The image itself shows a video thumbnail with a duration of 0:06 seconds. The video captures a bright, fiery object streaking through the sky, resembling a fireball. The fireball is predominantly white and orange, with a trail of smoke or vapor trailing behind it as it moves downward. The background is a clear blue sky
